record.bible_text: Call<WH07121><WTH8798> now, if there be<WH03426> any that will answer<WH06030><WTH8802> thee; and to which of the saints<WH06918> wilt thou turn<WH06437><WTH8799>? <RF>turn: or, look?<Rf>
For wrath<WH03708> killeth<WH02026><WTH8799> the foolish man<WH0191>, and envy<WH07068> slayeth<WH04191><WTH8686> the silly one<WH06601><WTH8802>. <RF>envy: or, indignation<Rf>
I have seen<WH07200><WTH8804> the foolish<WH0191> taking root<WH08327><WTH8688>: but suddenly<WH06597> I cursed<WH05344><WTH8799> his habitation<WH05116>.

His children<WH01121> are far<WH07368><WTH8799> from safety<WH03468>, and they are crushed<WH01792><WTH8691> in the gate<WH08179>, neither <FI>is there<Fi> any to deliver<WH05337><WTH8688> <FI>them<Fi> .

Whose harvest<WH07105> the hungry<WH07457> eateth up<WH0398><WTH8799>, and taketh<WH03947><WTH8799> it even out<WH0413> of the thorns<WH06791>, and the robber<WH06782> swalloweth up<WH07602><WTH8804> their substance<WH02428>.<CM>
Although affliction<WH0205> cometh not forth<WH03318><WTH8799> of the dust<WH06083>, neither doth trouble<WH05999> spring out<WH06779><WTH8799> of the ground<WH0127>; <RF>affliction: or, iniquity<Rf>

Yet man<WH0120> is born<WH03205><WTH8795> unto trouble<WH05999>, as the sparks<WH01121><WH07565> fly<WH05774><WTH8800> upward<WH01361><WTH8686>. <RF>trouble: or, labour<Rf> <RF>sparks...: Heb. the sons of the burning coal lift up to fly<Rf>
I would seek<WH0199><WH01875><WTH8799> unto God<WH0410>, and unto God<WH0430> would I commit<WH07760><WTH8799> my cause<WH01700>:

Which doeth<WH06213><WTH8802> great things<WH01419> and unsearchable<WH0369><WH02714>; marvellous things<WH06381><WTH8737> without number<WH04557>: <RF>unsearchable: Heb. there is no search<Rf> <RF>without...: Heb. till there be no number<Rf>
Who giveth<WH05414><WTH8802> rain<WH04306> upon<WH06440> the earth<WH0776>, and sendeth<WH07971><WTH8802> waters<WH04325> upon<WH06440> the fields<WH02351>: <RF>fields: Heb. outplaces<Rf>
To set up<WH07760><WTH8800> on high<WH04791> those that be low<WH08217>; that those which mourn<WH06937><WTH8802> may be exalted<WH07682><WTH8804> to safety<WH03468>.

He disappointeth<WH06565><WTH8688> the devices<WH04284> of the crafty<WH06175>, so that their hands<WH03027> cannot perform<WH06213><WTH8799> <FI>their<Fi> enterprise<WH08454>. <RF>their enterprise: or, any thing<Rf>
He taketh<WH03920><WTH8802> the wise<WH02450> in their own craftiness<WH06193>: and the counsel<WH06098> of the froward<WH06617><WTH8737> is carried headlong<WH04116><WTH8737>.
They meet<WH06298><WTH8762> with darkness<WH02822> in the daytime<WH03119>, and grope<WH04959><WTH8762> in the noonday<WH06672> as in the night<WH03915>. <RF>meet...: or, run into<Rf>
But he saveth<WH03467><WTH8686> the poor<WH034> from the sword<WH02719>, from their mouth<WH06310>, and from the hand<WH03027> of the mighty<WH02389>.
So the poor<WH01800> hath hope<WH08615>, and iniquity<WH05766> stoppeth<WH07092><WTH8804> her mouth<WH06310>.<CM>
Behold, happy<WH0835> <FI>is<Fi> the man<WH0582> whom God<WH0433> correcteth<WH03198><WTH8686>: therefore despise<WH03988><WTH8799> not thou the chastening<WH04148> of the Almighty<WH07706>:
For he maketh sore<WH03510><WTH8686>, and bindeth up<WH02280><WTH8799>: he woundeth<WH04272><WTH8799>, and his hands<WH03027> make whole<WH07495><WTH8799>.
He shall deliver<WH05337><WTH8686> thee in six<WH08337> troubles<WH06869>: yea, in seven<WH07651> there shall no evil<WH07451> touch<WH05060><WTH8799> thee.
In famine<WH07458> he shall redeem<WH06299><WTH8804> thee from death<WH04194>: and in war<WH04421> from the power<WH03027> of the sword<WH02719>. <RF>power: Heb. hands<Rf>

Thou shalt be hid<WH02244><WTH8735> from the scourge<WH07752> of the tongue<WH03956>: neither shalt thou be afraid<WH03372><WTH8799> of destruction<WH07701> when it cometh<WH0935><WTH8799>. <RF>from...: or, when the tongue scourgeth<Rf>
At destruction<WH07701> and famine<WH03720> thou shalt laugh<WH07832><WTH8799>: neither shalt thou be afraid<WH03372><WTH8799> of the beasts<WH02416> of the earth<WH0776>.
For thou shalt be in league<WH01285> with the stones<WH068> of the field<WH07704>: and the beasts<WH02416> of the field<WH07704> shall be at peace<WH07999><WTH8717> with thee.

And thou shalt know<WH03045><WTH8804> that thy tabernacle<WH0168> <FI>shall be<Fi> in peace<WH07965>; and thou shalt visit<WH06485><WTH8804> thy habitation<WH05116>, and shalt not sin<WH02398><WTH8799>. <RF>thy tabernacle...: or, peace is thy tabernacle<Rf> <RF>sin: or, err<Rf>
Thou shalt know<WH03045><WTH8804> also that thy seed<WH02233> <FI>shall be<Fi> great<WH07227>, and thine offspring<WH06631> as the grass<WH06212> of the earth<WH0776>. <RF>great: or, much<Rf>

Thou shalt come<WH0935><WTH8799> to <FI>thy<Fi> grave<WH06913> in a full age<WH03624>, like as a shock of corn<WH01430> cometh in<WH05927><WTH8800> in his season<WH06256>. <RF>cometh in: Heb. ascendeth<Rf>
Lo this, we have searched<WH02713><WTH8804> it, so it <FI>is<Fi> ; hear<WH08085><WTH8798> it, and know<WH03045><WTH8798> thou <FI>it<Fi> for thy good. <RF>for...: Heb. for thyself<Rf><CM>
